task.name: Sweep_camp_for_MOOP
task.when: Once per shift and after camp strike

resources.resource: Enough people to span the sweep area at arm's-width spacing

step.action: Line up at one edge of the sweep area.
Spread the line until each person is about one arm's width from the next person.
Walk the line forward together while scanning the playa directly ahead.
Put every piece of MOOP in 📦 MOOP_Buckets.
Repeat the line sweep across the camp, serving, art-car, and porta-potty areas.

passWhen.criterion: Every assigned area was covered by an arm's-width line sweep.
No visible MOOP remains in the swept areas.
